propositions: The citation section `[rebar:<id>]` in docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md does not explicitly state that the edge must be DIRECT, creating ambiguity about whether transitive dependencies satisfy the requirement.

The verifier `det_citation._edge_verified` implements direct-edge-only validation (no recursion), so transitive/indirect dependencies do not satisfy citations despite the shipped documentation not clarifying this.
A transitive dependency between tickets caused a citation to fail silently with no warning when the documentation did not make the direct-edge requirement explicit.
The fix is documentation-only: add explicit language to the citation section stating the edge must be DIRECT and that transitive/indirect dependencies do not count.
